parameters.query: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT ss_id FROM author_cache WHERE name = $1), '') AS cache_ss_id;
INSERT INTO author_cache(name, ss_id) VALUES($1,$2) ON CONFLICT (name) DO UPDATE SET ss_id=EXCLUDED.ss_id;

parameters.name: search_query
parameters.value: cat:cs.LG AND (abs:"integrated gradients" OR abs:"feature attribution" OR abs:"post-training quantization" OR abs:"model quantization")

parameters.query: SELECT $1 AS dedup_key, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM papers WHERE dedup_key = $1) AS already_seen;
